## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Shēnrì ér běn jīng* (T536) is a one-fascicle Liú-Sòng translation by Guṇabhadra 求那跋陀羅 ([求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85)). It is the third Chinese translation of the Candraprabha-kumāra cycle (cf. [KR6i0164](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0164), [KR6i0165](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0165)).

**Abstract**

Guṇabhadra's translation provides a smoother-style version of the Candraprabha-Sundaya narrative. Translation dated to his productive period (435–468 CE).
